Package com.helix.api.cache

Interface DistributedRuleCache

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
All Known Implementing Classes:
L4RedisRuleCache
public interface DistributedRuleCache extends AutoCloseable
Contract for out-of-process distributed rule cache tiers (e.g. Redis, Memcached). Stores compiled HotSpot rule bytecode keyed by deterministic rule hashes.
